note: Screen-recorded D3 run, 2026-09-25: a registered USER account (testusera) built on_receive XLM → swap (XLM→USDC, 1%) → split USDC 60/40 in the builder, used every Swapper input on camera (assets, the asset-mismatch and same-asset errors, the slippage floor and ceiling clamps, the preview quote, Advanced with the pinned router and its stellar.expert link, the deadline), deployed it with Freighter through the app's own factory and triggered it with 50 XLM. A second take on a phone shows the docked sheet. Narrated, with burned-in captions.

segments.shows: New flow; On Receive, Swap and Split added from the palette and connected
Asset-mismatch error on the Swap panel (trigger receives USDC, swap takes XLM); switching the trigger to XLM clears it
Asset In lists USDC as disabled, the upstream asset being set by the previous step
Asset Out onto XLM raises the same-asset error; back to USDC clears it
Max slippage 0.1 is raised to the 0.3% floor on blur; 200 is lowered to 100%; set to 1%
Preview: You send 50 XLM, live Soroswap quote ≈ 5.2731 USDC
Advanced: the pinned Soroswap router, opened on stellar.expert, and the deadline
Split recipients set to two wallets; the must-add-to-100 error; shares 60/40
Deploy with the English preview and pipeline architecture; deployment page ACTIVE on TESTNET
Trigger page (the QR code is offered too): 50 XLM, Freighter connected and the deposit signed
Live events: RECEIVE 50 XLM and PAYOUT 'Swapped 50 XLM → 5.2731 USDC'; the transaction opened on stellar.expert
Keyboard: Tab moves a visible ring across the edges and the On Receive node, Enter opens its panel, Escape closes it with focus back on the node
Phone: the Swap panel docked as a bottom sheet, scrolled, Advanced opened, You send edited with the phone keyboard up, closed; the English preview expanded; Ask AI opened with no sheet on screen

notCovered: The keyboard segment opens the On Receive node's panel, not the Swap panel, and does not tab through the Swapper's fields. The SOW (§6.1 l.299) asks only for a recording of building a Swapper flow with the new inputs; the Swap panel's full keyboard walk is asserted by tests/e2e/d3-swap-panel.spec.ts, which passed against paiflow.xyz on this build (20 passed, 6 skipped). The flow ends in a Split rather than #639's Pay.
pipelineSource: The deploy_pipeline return value in the deploy transaction, in pipeline order; each WASM hash is sha256 of the code fetched by contract id from testnet RPC. The swapper's is D1's.
eventsSource: Decoded from the trigger transaction's contract events (19-recording-run.getTransaction.json): deposit on the trigger, SoroswapRouter swap [500000000, 52731437], swap on the swapper, payout on the splitter, and the two USDC transfers above.
